✅ I added section 6, "Responsive dynamics", to `Kit · Grids` (`254:32591`), and its report is committed in `kit/grids.md`.

- **Count-driven widths:** Three FILL cards come out 164 wide each. A 4th FILL card shrinks all four to 117. With a min width of 150 on a wrap row, the 4th wraps instead.
- **Icon + title:** With a plain HUG title, the long title drops under the icon from 360 and overflows at 280 and 220. Pinning the icon and letting the title FILL fixes it, either wrapping beside the icon or truncating to one line. Truncating keeps the card height steady. The wrapped version breaks mid-word at 220.
- **Strong margins:** I added this to the Notes box rather than changing any layout. Sections 1, 3 and 6 still use deliberately narrow specimens to show widths, and the note says so.

⚠️ Two task-log lines I wrote by hand earlier are malformed, and the guard hook has since blocked hand-writes to `.jsonl`. I added a correct line with `append.mjs` but did not remove the bad ones, so they may need a clean-up if a live page reads that log.
